notes.en: [[character:astra-yao]] needs about 3,430 ATK to get the full team-wide buff from her Core Skill. Reaching that ATK breakpoint with your set bonus, main stats, substats and W-Engine is the most important thing to do with her.

Target stats at level 60: ATK 3,430+, HP 10,500+, DEF 800+ and Energy Regen 0 to 130% (depends on your 2-piece set, Disc 6 and W-Engine). More Energy Regen is the same as more free Quick Assists, so pick it up whenever it does not stop you reaching the ATK goal.
After those goals, stack either CRIT or Anomaly Proficiency, but not both. Any amount of either helps.

She takes almost no field time: swap her in at the start to use her Special, use her for Quick Assists and spend her Ultimate in Stun windows. DPS agents that need a lot of field time benefit most, such as [[character:miyabi]], [[character:yanagi]], [[character:jane-doe]] and [[character:burnice]].

[[character:evelyn]] is a particularly good partner, because her Ultimate turns the next 2 Quick Assists into Chain Attacks. Other strong attacker partners include [[character:ye-shunguang]], [[character:soldier-0-anby]], [[character:seed]], [[character:soldier-11]], [[character:zhu-yuan]] and [[character:nekomata]].
Double Support teams with [[character:nicole]] or [[character:trigger]] work especially well, since both take very little field time. On some DPS agents it is their best team by far.
